title: Shorter Rental Leases for Private and HDB Properties to Accommodate Construction Delays due to COVID-19 Circuit Breaker Measures
what_it_is: Shorter Rental Leases for Private and HDB Properties to Accommodate Construction Delays due to COVID-19 Circuit Breaker Measures

sections.label: Short-term rentals for displaced families
sections.summary: Asked whether URA and HDB will permit rentals shorter than three months for private property and six months for HDB flats for families displaced by COVID-19 construction delays.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
sentences.text: asked the Minister for National Development whether URA and HDB will permit rentals of residential premises that are shorter than three months for private property and six months for HDB flats, to provide accommodation for families displaced by construction work delays due to the COVID-19 circuit breaker measures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: However, in view of the COVID-19 situation, HDB and URA have been exercising flexibility on a case-by-case basis for households who are in genuine difficulties and need temporary accommodation.

sections.label: Renovation exemptions during circuit breaker
sections.summary: Homeowners impacted by the circuit breaker had renovation works suspended; minor works were exempted so homes could be made safe.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: On the first point, we are certainly aware that there are homeowners who are impacted by the circuit breaker, having made certain transactions with the hope of moving to their new flats and now finding that renovation works have been suspended because of the circuit breaker.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: One, at the start of the circuit breaker, for very minor renovation works, we gave some exemption for some of these works to be completed as much as possible, so that the homes can be made safe and people can move in quickly.

sections.label: Measures to help impacted homeowners
sections.summary: Measures include pushing back transaction timelines, moving in with relatives, subsidised serviced apartments and interim rental flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: For example, number one is working to see if the transaction timelines can be pushed back; number two, checking to see if the homeowners who are impacted can move with relatives and friends; number three, working with serviced apartment operators, some of whom have agreed to offer subsidised rates for impacted homeowners and these can be offered to the homeowners who need temporary accommodations; number four, we looked at the worst case and for those who are really urgent and have difficulties, we offered interim rental flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, there is a range of different measures that we are doing to help these people who are impacted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: We will certainly remind the agencies to be prompt and responsive to some of these appeals when they show up.

sections.label: Resuming suspended renovation works
sections.summary: Suspended renovation works may resume in Phase One with safeguards, while new projects are deferred.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: For the works that had already started but suspended because of the circuit breaker, we are actually going to allow that in Phase One.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: So, even in Phase One, so long as the firms are able to put in place the relevant safeguards and assure that the workers are safe, then for these renovation works for projects that had started earlier but were suspended because of the circuit breaker, we will accord some priority and let them resume first.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: For new projects, we will defer or suggest to the homeowners and contractors who are embarking on new renovation projects, that these be pushed back later.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: But as Ms Lim said, we have indeed made the commitment that if there are any contractors who will come forward and say, "I have the workers.
